The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Make of the supplied material shall be RUGGEDCOM, HIRCHMAN, GARRRETCOM, GE REASON a nd BELDEN India (As per COV) or any Other equivalent make meeting all the technical specific ations and IEC 61850-3 requirements. In addition to this, switches shall be compliant with IEC 61850 and shall be suitable for the substation environment and shall conform to type tests as per IEC 61850-3. Shortlisting Criteria related to Technical experience: The Bidder must have successfully executed the Similar* Work during last seven (7) years as on the last da te of Bid submission (soft copy) One Single contract of value not less than Rs. 4.4 Lakhs OR Two contracts each of value not less than Rs. 2.73 Lakhs OR Three contracts each of value not less than Rs. 2.18 Lakh

*Similar Works shall mean successful execution of supply and/or installation of Industrial Ethernet Switche s, Managed Network Switches, Communication Switches, SCADA/SAS Networking Equipment, Industrial Ne tworking Equipment or equivalent communication systems in Power Sector Utilities, Substations, Power Pla nts, Transmission Systems, Process Industries or other Industrial Applications. .
